gloss: to make a mistake, to be wrong

definitions.gloss: to make a mistake, to be wrong
definitions.explanation: To do something incorrectly or be mistaken.

examples.japanese: {答|こた}えを{間違|まちが}った。
{間違|まちが}っていたら{教|おし}えて。

notes:
{間違|まちが}う is an intransitive verb meaning to be wrong or make a mistake.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Related: {間違|まちが}える (transitive, to mistake one thing for another)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {道|みち}を{間違|まちが}う (take the wrong road)
- {答|こた}えを{間違|まちが}う (get the answer wrong)
- {間違|まちが}っている (is wrong/incorrect)

RELATED WORDS:
- {間違|まちが}い: mistake, error (noun)
- {間違|まちが}いない: no mistake, definitely
